# b06 round 3: data names owned by save menu, text, input/Pak and cutscene modules

# Stay D_: D_80090358 (tail of the 0x80-byte header read buffer, unreferenced), D_80061650/D_800616B4/D_800616B8/D_800616C0/D_800616C8 (local-variable initializers that SaveMenu_UpdateSlotList, Text_UpdateAndDrawWindows and Text_DrawAdvanceIndicator copy to the stack), D_80061820 (unreferenced digit string), D_8006C938/D_8006C93C/D_8006C940 (rest of the 25-entry save dialog table, reached only by indexing save_menu_dialog_messages_save), the 36E60 message byte arrays and the other 36E60 textures (entries of named tables only), D_8006CC74 and D_8006CC80 (write-only), D_8007A8C0/D_8007A8EC (unreferenced .bss gaps).

column3: SaveMenu_Update: bits 0-2 the state (0 slot list, 1 repair, 2 load, 3 save, 4 delete, 5 dialog, 6 delay), 0x2000 draw the operation panel, 0x4000 Pak checked, 0x8000 close (clears menu_flags 0x8000), 0x800 yes/no box (SaveMenu_UpdateDialog), 0x1000 re-check the Pak (set by SaveMenu_Init)
which dialog SaveMenu_UpdateDialog shows: indexes save_menu_dialog_rects and the two dialog message tables; set by the Pak check and the load/save/delete/repair results
SaveMenu_DrawOperationPanel indexes save_menu_operation_panel_rects/messages with it; set to 0 (Pak check, SaveMenu_Update), 1 load, 2 save, 3 delete, 4 repair when the operation starts
Pak error code stored by the check, load, save, delete and repair paths; SaveMenu_RepairPak passes it to Pak_TryRepair

row 0/1 of the yes/no box: SaveMenu_UpdateDialog toggles it with the stick, draws the cursor at save_menu_choice_cursor_positions[it] and branches on it; Text_UpdateAndDrawWindows stores the choice of 0x80000 windows here
signed frame count: the save-menu states set 10 (or 2/4), SaveMenu_UpdateDialog ignores input until it is < 0, SaveMenu_UpdateDelay returns to the slot list when it goes < 0
slot index SaveMenu_UpdateSlotList moves with the stick; load, save, delete and repair index save_menu_file_entries/save_menu_save_headers with it
SaveMenu_UpdateSlotList moves the slot only when it is 0, then counts it up modulo 16 while the stick is held, 0 when released
SaveMenu_RepairPak increments it after a successful repair, SaveMenu_Update zeroes it after the Pak check; SaveMenu_CheckControllerPak shows dialog 24 when it is nonzero and the Pak is still full

17 (Pak file number, ext_name byte) entries SaveMenu_RefreshFileList builds from pak_game_file_scans; -1 ends the list, -2 is the new-file entry added in save mode; load/save/delete use [save_menu_selected_slot]

16 x 0x68 headers (player stats, play time, day count, map/subarea, return points, options): SaveMenu_CaptureGameState fills, Pak_WriteFile writes as bytes 0..0x80 of the file, SaveMenu_UpdateSlotList shows, SaveMenu_RestoreGameState copies back
chest, spirit, inventory and boss flags: SaveMenu_CaptureGameState copies them in, SaveMenu_SaveSelectedFile writes it at file offset 0x80, SaveMenu_LoadSelectedFile/RestoreGameState copy them back
SaveMenu_RefreshFileList reads each file's 0x80-byte header here (Pak_ReadFile) and copies it into save_menu_save_headers
SaveMenu_LoadSelectedFile reads the file's 0xE0 bytes at offset 0x80 here and copies them into save_menu_game_state_block

{-1, 0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 30}: Text_OpenWindow sets the per-character delay to [0] + menu_text_delay_option; Text_UpdateAndDrawWindows sets it to [code & 7] * menu_text_delay_option for control codes 0xE1..0xE8
(x, y, w, h) per window type 0..7; Text_OpenWindow(type >= 0) copies [type] into the slot
(x, y, w, h) of choice windows: Text_MeasureChoiceWindow sets w/h from the rows, Text_OpenWindow(type < 0) copies it into the slot
5 textures Text_DrawTexturedRect selects by its type argument (copied to a local)
(w, h, cms, cmt, masks, maskt) per Text_DrawTexturedRect type, used for the tile load (copied to a local)
Text_OpenWindow increments it, Text_UpdateAndDrawWindows decrements it when a window closes; player, cutscene and core code wait for it to be 0
row confirmed in a choice window (Text_UpdateAndDrawWindows); the rest-choice code (9D50) sets -1 before opening, Player code (3F50) tests == 0
row count and row pointers the caller fills (9D50) before Text_OpenWindow copies them into the window
4 x 0x9FC window records (flags, rect, delay, choice cursor, speaker name, choice rows, text buffers): Text_ResetWindow/OpenWindow/UpdateAndDrawWindows and the draw helpers
Text_IsStickAdvanceHeld only counts the stick when it is nonzero; Text_OpenWindow clears it and nothing in the tree sets it
Text_IsStickAdvanceHeld counts frames with the stick past radius 60 and returns 1 at 5; zeroed on release and by Text_ResetStickAdvanceTimer
(glyph width, height, x advance, line height) records: Text_DrawEncodedString draws and advances with [text_font_index], line height on control code 0xE0
render-state list for text: Text_DrawEncodedString (control code 0xFE), Text_UpdateAndDrawWindows, Menu_Update and SaveMenu_SetTextDrawState call it
Text_DrawEncodedString sets it from control codes 0xC0..0xCF and indexes text_font_metrics with it
Text_DrawEncodedString sets it from control codes 0xD0..0xDF and adds it to every glyph advance
first port without errors and of standard type (Input_InitControllers, -1 = none); Input_ReadController reads it, the save menu, Pak code and Intro_Update use it
Input_ReadController copies the port's OSContPad stick_x here
Input_ReadController copies the port's OSContPad stick_y here
Input_ReadController copies the port's button bits here each frame
Input_ReadController: buttons & input_previous_button_inverse, the newly pressed bits
Input_ReadController stores ~buttons here for the next frame's edge test; Input_InitControllers zeroes it
OSMesgQueue Input_InitControllers creates and registers for OS_EVENT_SI; controller reads and every Pak call pass it
OSPfs per port: Pak_ScanGameFiles and the init/repair calls set them up, Pak_Allocate/Delete/Read/WriteFile use [port]
per port: controller status (Input_InitControllers), found-file count and full/found flags, ext_name byte per note and free pages (Pak_ScanGameFiles); the save menu and intro read it
pattern bits osContInit fills in Input_InitControllers, which tests bit i per port
4 OSContStatus osContInit fills in Input_InitControllers (errno, type, Pak status tested per port)
OSMesg storage of input_si_queue (osCreateMesgQueue/osSetEventMesg in Input_InitControllers)
4 OSContPad osContGetReadData fills in Input_ReadController
game_name Pak_ScanGameFiles compares with each note's; Pak_AllocateGameFile/DeleteGameFile pass it to libultra
zero ext_name Pak_AllocateGameFile copies to a local and sets byte 0 of before osPfsAllocateFile
zero ext_name Pak_DeleteGameFile copies to a local and sets byte 0 of before osPfsDeleteFile
Cutscene_ResetSequence zeroes it, Cutscene_StartNextScene takes entry [it++]; UpdateScene/EndScene end the sequence at 14
Cutscene_StartNextScene zeroes it, Cutscene_UpdateScene applies the camera track at it and increments it
camera track length Cutscene_StartNextScene copies; Cutscene_UpdateScene starts the fade 0x31 frames before it
camera track of the current scene (Cutscene_StartNextScene); Cutscene_UpdateScene samples it through Cutscene_ApplyCameraFrame
Cutscene_UpdateAndDrawImageCues compares it with the next cue's start frame and increments it; zeroed per scene
next cue to start: set per scene by Cutscene_StartNextScene, advanced by Cutscene_UpdateAndDrawImageCues when its frame is reached
32 (frames left, cue) slots Cutscene_UpdateAndDrawImageCues fills, fades in/out and draws; cleared per scene

256-colour palette loaded before Text_DrawTexturedRect's textures (window fill, lines, cursor, advance icon) in Text_UpdateAndDrawWindows/DrawAdvanceIndicator and the title overlay's box; glyphs use the DMA'd 16-colour palettes instead
256-colour palette Menu_DrawSprite and Menu_DrawNumber/ZeroPad load (menu_flags 0x10) for the menu_sprite_tex textures
5 messages SaveMenu_DrawOperationPanel draws, [save_menu_operation_panel_index]
5 (x, y, w, h) boxes SaveMenu_DrawOperationPanel draws, [save_menu_operation_panel_index]

25-entry dialog message table (with D_8006C938..) SaveMenu_UpdateDialog uses in save mode (menu_flags & 4: SaveMenu_Init(4), the only mode whose A press runs SaveSelectedFile); entries 0..3 are also the yes/no box rows in every mode
25-entry dialog message table SaveMenu_UpdateDialog uses when menu_flags & 4 is clear (SaveMenu_Init(0) load, SaveMenu_Init(8) delete)
25 (x, y, w, h) boxes SaveMenu_UpdateDialog draws, [save_menu_dialog_index]; [0]/[2] for the yes/no box
4 (x, y): SaveMenu_UpdateDialog draws the cursor at [save_menu_choice_cursor] (+2 with save_menu_flags 0x10)
labels SaveMenu_UpdateSlotList draws per slot, chosen by the header's saved map id and subarea
render setup Cutscene_UpdateAndDrawImageCues calls before drawing the cue images
Cutscene_StartEntry sets 60; Cutscene_UpdateMessageSequence counts it down while no text window is open and opens the next message at 0 (15 after each)
Cutscene_StartEntry copies the entry's message count; Cutscene_UpdateMessageSequence decrements it per message and ends the scene at 0
Cutscene_StartEntry copies the entry's message list; Cutscene_UpdateMessageSequence copies (message, speaker name), opens the window type and advances it

text option 0..4 (default 2): Menu_UpdateOptionsPage moves it on the upper row (shown as 4 - value), Text_OpenWindow sets the per-character delay from it (0 = whole page at once, Text_UpdateAndDrawWindows), the save header stores it (+0x62)
256-colour palette Menu_DrawBackground loads for menu_bg_strip_tex
menu_bg_strip_tex[0], drawn by Menu_DrawBackground (64 x 32 CI8)
menu_bg_strip_tex[1], drawn by Menu_DrawBackground (64 x 32 CI8)
menu_bg_strip_tex[2], drawn by Menu_DrawBackground (64 x 32 CI8)
menu_bg_strip_tex[3], drawn by Menu_DrawBackground (64 x 24 CI8)
Text_DrawTexturedRect type 0 (16 x 16): the window body in Text_DrawWindowFrame, Text_AnimateWindowSize and Text_DrawFramedRect
Text_DrawTexturedRect type 1 (40 x 13): Text_DrawWindowContents draws it at the window's top left before the speaker name, only when there is one
Text_DrawTexturedRect type 2 (12 x 12): the bobbing icon of Text_DrawAdvanceIndicator
Text_DrawTexturedRect type 3 (1 x 1): the window edge lines and drop-shadow strips (Text_DrawWindowFrame, Text_AnimateWindowSize, Text_DrawAdvanceIndicator)
Text_DrawTexturedRect type 4 (12 x 12): the cursor Text_UpdateAndDrawWindows draws beside the selected choice row
Intro_Update runs the boot Controller Pak check (scan, Pak full / no Pak / error screens) while it is 0 and sets 1 when done; main .data, so it survives overlay reloads
Intro_Update returns without running the intro phases the first time it gets past the Pak check and sets this to 1; nothing resets it
